name: Guangzhou Good Morning 2020

venue.name: Guangzhou Nanwu Middle School
venue.address: No. 81 Xingyuan Street, Jiangnanxi Road, Haizhu District

information:
The structure of the competition in Guangzhou this year has been modified due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
Competitors are only allowed to compete in one of the two competitions, **[Guangzhou Good Morning 2020](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Guangzhou-Good-Morning-2020)** and **[Guangzhou Good Afternoon 2020](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Guangzhou-Good-Afternoon-2020)**, in two half-days respectively.
